source_text: Camelus ruminat nec findit; sus findit nec ruminat — immunda. Alterum sine altero non sufficit. Fides cum operibus.
pass_a_gloss: Camel chews-cud nor splits; swine splits nor chews — unclean. One without other not suffices. Faith with works.
pass_b_english: The [[camel chews but does not part; the swine parts but does not chew — unclean >> Bible:Leviticus 11:4-7]]. One without the other fails. Faith with works.
